description: This is a Java test file for the PersonDAO class, containing unit tests for methods interacting with PersonAttributeType and PersonName objects within the OpenMRS API.

classes.name: PersonDAOTest
classes.description: A test class extending BaseContextSensitiveTest, containing unit tests for PersonDAO methods.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes the PersonDAO instance before each test by fetching it from the application context.

methods.name: getSavedPersonAttributeTypeName_shouldGetSavedPersonAttributeTypeNameFromDatabase
methods.description: Tests retrieving the saved name of a PersonAttributeType from the database.

methods.name: getPersonName_shouldGetSavedPersonNameById
methods.description: Tests fetching a PersonName by its ID.

methods.name: getPersonName_shouldNotGetPersonNameGivenInvalidId
methods.description: Tests that an invalid ID returns null when fetching a PersonName.

methods.name: getSavedPersonAttributeTypeSearchable_shouldFetchSearchablePropertyForAPersonAttributeTypeBypassingCache
methods.description: Tests fetching the searchable property of a PersonAttributeType from the database, ensuring the cache is bypassed.
